examples.arabic: هو سأل ست عن الطريق لمطعم قريب
examples.english: He asked a woman about the way to a nearby restaurant.
examples.transliteration: howa saal set an el tareeq le mataam areeb.

examples.english: I saw an old woman and decided to ask her.
examples.transliteration: Shoft sett kibeera we qarrart as'alha.

examples.arabic: شفت ست بتبيع خضار كتير وقالتلي يا بنتي انتي هتطبخي كل ده لوحدك وضحكت
examples.english: I saw a woman selling many vegetables and she told me "My daughter, will you cook all this by yourself?" and laughed
examples.transliteration: Shoft sett betebia khodar kteer we qaletli Ya benti enti hatetbokhi kol dah lewahdek we dehekt
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

examples.arabic: الجدة فضلت تسأل عن الاسعار وتتكلم مع البياعين كتير وتقول اهلا بيكي لكل ست بتقابلها
examples.english: The grandmother kept asking about prices and talking a lot with the sellers, saying "Ahlan beeki" to every woman she met
examples.transliteration: El-gedda faddalet tes'al 'an el-as'ar we tetkallem ma' el-bayya'een kiteer we te'ul "Ahlan beeki" le koll sett bet'abelha

examples.arabic: وهي في طريقها للمترو، عدّت على ست كبيرة كانت بتبيع فول، فقالتلها: "صباح الخير يا والدة! الفول لسه سخن؟"
examples.english: On her way to the metro, she passed an old woman selling fūl, and said to her: "Good morning, mother! Is the fūl still hot?"
examples.transliteration: We heya fi ṭari2ha lel-metro, 3addet 3ala sett kebira kanet betibee3 fūl, fa-2aletlaha: "Sabah el-kheir ya walda! El-fūl lessa sokhn?"
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Journey in Khan el-Khalili: A Morning Full of Greetings

examples.arabic: الست اللي هتطبخ العشا كانت بتجهز اكل حلو اوي
examples.english: The woman who will cook dinner was preparing very delicious food.
examples.transliteration: El sett elly hatatbakh el 3asha kanet betgahez akl 7elw awy
